meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 装上后会在容器里安装 mnemon，并在每次容器启动时注册 Claude Code hooks：回复前先调取相关记忆，每轮结束后把新内容写入记忆。记忆存放在挂载的 .claude/ 目录，重启容器后仍在。
howto.when: 仅对运行默认 Claude provider 的 agent group 生效（container.json 里 provider 缺省或写 claude）；设了其他 provider 的分组不会调用 claude CLI，hooks 不会跑。

say.text: 给容器装上 mnemon 持久记忆
确认 mnemon hooks 注册好了吗
say.note: 查看容器内 settings.json 的 hooks

say.text: 清掉这个 agent 的所有记忆

howto.what_en: Installs mnemon in the agent container. On each start it registers Claude Code hooks: relevant memory surfaces before the agent replies, and new insights are stored after each turn. Memory lives in the mounted .claude/ dir and survives restarts.
howto.when_en: Only applies to agent groups using the default Claude provider (container.json 'provider' absent or 'claude'). Groups with another provider never invoke the claude CLI, so the registered hooks do not run.

say_en.text: Install mnemon persistent memory in the container.
say_en.note: Edits Dockerfile and entrypoint, then rebuilds

say_en.text: Clear all memory for this agent.
